Callout.Name: Escape Vehicle Reported
Callout.Message: Vehicle seen taking on a passenger at the perimeter road.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle heading for the highway, one passenger boarded.

Script.Line: A car came up to the perimeter road and it did not stop.
Somebody came over the wall and got straight into it.
I have half the plate. Do not ask me for the rest of it.

Lines.Approach: Somebody got into it at the fence line and it went for the highway. That is an escape attempt in progress.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
